findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler cannot be instantiated
findings.description: Switching to `StatefulDetectorHandler` leaves four abstract members unimplemented: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates this registered class directly, so accessing it for `metric_alert_fire` now raises `TypeError`. Implement the abstract contract or retain a concrete no-op handler until implementation.

findings.title: Occurrence assertions do not validate payload contents
findings.description: Every mock occurrence uses the same ID, while `IssueOccurrence.__eq__` compares only IDs. Consequently, the new result and Kafka-call assertions cannot detect incorrect fingerprints or priorities. This already masks the mismatched expected `"val1"` fingerprint in `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`, which evaluates `"group_key"`. Assert occurrence fields explicitly and verify the builder receives the actual group key, value, and priority.
